findings.interpretation: Military cable is a high-pressure hideout progression component in pinned SPT 4.1.3, but the sampled construction requirements explicitly require spawned-in-session items. A trader-purchased unit therefore does not substitute for those FIR-style construction requirements. The fixed Prapor and Mechanic assorts contain no Military cable reference, so the reviewed candidate does not create a direct fixed-trader barter shortcut in those two primary economic paths.

decision.reason: The candidate remains viable only as bounded field-logistics availability. Its trader-bought copies must not be represented as a hideout-progression shortcut, and Economy Admiral still owns price/supply pressure approval.
requiredBeforeMaterialization: Economy Admiral confirms that 4 per reset / buy 2 does not create unacceptable flea or barter pressure
Relationship manifest-to-assort implementation preserves finite supply and LL2 standing gate
no quest or capability path is added that treats trader-bought Military cable as spawned-in-session
runtime candidate remains separate from frozen 0.1.0 until its own later milestone
